The test image shows soybean seeds inside an open, dried pod. Key observations:
- Seeds have yellowish/tan base coloration
- Dark black/purple-black irregular blotching/staining on the seed coats
- The pod itself appears mature and dry (brown)
- The dark staining pattern on the seed surface closely matches Purple_Seed_Stain

Comparing with the reference: The Purple_Seed_Stain reference shows exactly this pattern — seeds with varying degrees of dark purple-to-black discoloration on otherwise yellow/tan seeds, including within open pods (bottom-right panel). The test image matches strongly, especially the dark blotchy seed coat discoloration visible in the open pod.
